views.name: batting_season_player_stint
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id AS player_id,
  year AS year,
  stint AS stint,
  team_id AS team_id,
  league_id AS league_id,
  g AS g,
  ab AS ab,
  r AS r,
  h AS h,
  "double" AS "double",
  triple AS triple,
  hr AS hr,
  rbi AS rbi,
  sb AS sb,
  cs AS cs,
  bb AS bb,
  so AS so,
  ibb AS ibb,
  hbp AS hbp,
  sh AS sh,
  sf AS sf,
  g_idp AS g_idp,
  CASE WHEN ab>0 THEN ROUND(CAST(h AS REAL)/ab,3) ELSE NULL END AS batting_average,
  -- approximate plate appearances: PA = AB + BB + HBP + SH + SF (when available)
  ( (ab IS NOT NULL) * CAST(ab AS INTEGER) + (bb IS NOT NULL) * CAST(bb AS INTEGER) + (hbp IS NOT NULL) * CAST(hbp AS INTEGER) + (sh IS NOT NULL) * CAST(sh AS INTEGER) + (sf IS NOT NULL) * CAST(sf AS INTEGER) ) AS plate_appearances
FROM batting
views.description: Normalized per-player-season batting stint rows with defensive nulls coerced to NULL and basic derived rates (batting average, plate_appearances). Use when you need cleaned batting stint-level stats for joins, aggregates, or rate calculations. | Use for: Compute season batting average or aggregate across stints; Join batting rates to player or team seasons; Filter players by minimal plate appearances and rank by batting_average

views.name: pitching_season_player_stint
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id AS player_id,
  year AS year,
  stint AS stint,
  team_id AS team_id,
  league_id AS league_id,
  w AS w,
  l AS l,
  g AS g,
  gs AS gs,
  cg AS cg,
  sho AS sho,
  sv AS sv,
  ipouts AS ipouts,
  h AS h,
  er AS er,
  hr AS hr,
  bb AS bb,
  so AS so,
  baopp AS baopp,
  era AS era,
  ibb AS ibb,
  wp AS wp,
  hbp AS hbp,
  bk AS bk,
  bfp AS bfp,
  gf AS gf,
  r AS r,
  sh AS sh,
  sf AS sf,
  g_idp AS g_idp,
  CASE WHEN ipouts IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(CAST(ipouts AS REAL)/3.0,3) ELSE NULL END AS innings_pitched,
  CASE WHEN ipouts>0 AND er IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND((CAST(er AS REAL) * 9.0) / (CAST(ipouts AS REAL)/3.0),2) ELSE era END AS era_passthrough
FROM pitching
views.description: Normalized per-player-season pitching stint rows with key pitching measures and derived earned-run-rate sanity (era_passthrough) and outs->innings conversion. Use as a cleaned pitching fact for aggregations or joins. | Use for: Aggregate pitcher workloads (IP) across stints or seasons; Compute ERA from raw outs and earned runs when era is missing; Join pitching stints to batting/fielding for two-way players

views.name: batting_season_agg_by_player_year
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id AS player_id,
  year AS year,
  SUM(COALESCE(g,0)) AS g,
  SUM(COALESCE(ab,0)) AS ab,
  SUM(COALESCE(r,0)) AS r,
  SUM(COALESCE(h,0)) AS h,
  SUM(COALESCE("double",0)) AS "double",
  SUM(COALESCE(triple,0)) AS triple,
  SUM(COALESCE(hr,0)) AS hr,
  SUM(COALESCE(rbi,0)) AS rbi,
  SUM(COALESCE(sb,0)) AS sb,
  SUM(COALESCE(cs,0)) AS cs,
  SUM(COALESCE(bb,0)) AS bb,
  SUM(COALESCE(so,0)) AS so,
  SUM(COALESCE(ibb,0)) AS ibb,
  SUM(COALESCE(hbp,0)) AS hbp,
  SUM(COALESCE(sh,0)) AS sh,
  SUM(COALESCE(sf,0)) AS sf,
  SUM(COALESCE(g_idp,0)) AS g_idp,
  CASE WHEN SUM(COALESCE(ab,0))>0 THEN ROUND(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(h,0)) AS REAL)/SUM(COALESCE(ab,0)),3) ELSE NULL END AS batting_average,
  (SUM(COALESCE(ab,0)) + SUM(COALESCE(bb,0)) + SUM(COALESCE(hbp,0)) + SUM(COALESCE(sh,0)) + SUM(COALESCE(sf,0))) AS plate_appearances
FROM batting
GROUP BY player_id, year
views.description: Aggregate batting across stints to one row per player-year with summed counting stats and computed batting_average and plate_appearances. Use for player-season level leaderboards and joins to team aggregates. | Use for: Player-season leaderboards (avg, HR, RBI); Filter players by minimum plate appearances and then rank

views.name: pitching_season_agg_by_player_year
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id AS player_id,
  year AS year,
  SUM(COALESCE(w,0)) AS w,
  SUM(COALESCE(l,0)) AS l,
  SUM(COALESCE(g,0)) AS g,
  SUM(COALESCE(gs,0)) AS gs,
  SUM(COALESCE(cg,0)) AS cg,
  SUM(COALESCE(sho,0)) AS sho,
  SUM(COALESCE(sv,0)) AS sv,
  SUM(COALESCE(ipouts,0)) AS ipouts,
  SUM(COALESCE(h,0)) AS h,
  SUM(COALESCE(er,0)) AS er,
  SUM(COALESCE(hr,0)) AS hr,
  SUM(COALESCE(bb,0)) AS bb,
  SUM(COALESCE(so,0)) AS so,
  SUM(COALESCE(bfp,0)) AS bfp,
  CASE WHEN SUM(COALESCE(ipouts,0))>0 THEN ROUND(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(ipouts,0)) AS REAL)/3.0,3) ELSE NULL END AS innings_pitched,
  CASE WHEN SUM(COALESCE(ipouts,0))>0 THEN ROUND((CAST(SUM(COALESCE(er,0)) AS REAL)*9.0)/(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(ipouts,0)) AS REAL)/3.0),2) ELSE NULL END AS era
FROM pitching
GROUP BY player_id, year
views.description: Aggregate pitching across stints to one row per player-year with summed counting stats, converted innings, and computed ERA when possible. Useful for player-season pitching leaderboards. | Use for: Pitcher-season leaderboards (wins, ERA, IP); Compare aggregated pitching workload across seasons

views.name: player_college_latest
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id AS player_id,
  college_id AS college_id,
  year AS year,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY year DESC) AS college_year_rank
FROM player_college
views.description: For each player, the most recent college association (latest year). Exposes a college_year_rank so downstream queries can filter for the latest college per player. Use when asking where a player most recently attended college. | Use for: Find the most recent college for each player; Filter players by college (latest association) and join to college metadata
